summary: ZCode Global Build Round 4 is live — GLM-5.3-Flash is free in ZCode from Sep 3–18 with 10 hours/day. Coding Plan members get it every day; new users get 100M free tokens on sign-up (one-time, valid until the window closes). This is a recurring promotional event: Round 1 (Aug 16, paused after ~1 hour), Round 2 (Aug 21-23), Round 3 (Sep 3, 1 day). Round 4 runs for 15 days.
claim_steps: Be a new ZCode user without an active paid coding plan.
Log into the ZCode desktop app during the promotional window.
Tap the card in the bottom-left corner to claim.
If the card is not visible, restart the app.
Use the tokens inside ZCode before Sep 18; unused tokens expire.
